$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Ring maths (moved)
blocks.note: Moved to @vostok/shapes (Shape maths, Basic outlines); handed on here, the same functions, so existing imports keep working. Import them from @vostok/shapes.
blocks.for: Area, bounds, move, rotate, mirror, simplify and centre rings and islands, plus a few basic outlines (circle, rounded rectangle, teardrop, dog tag).

blocks.name: 2D boolean ops
blocks.for: Union, subtract, intersect and offset 2D shapes through manifold-3d, without its memory leaks.

blocks.name: Blank shapes
blocks.for: The library of ready outlines for tags, charms and ornaments (hearts, stars, shields, animals, balls, trees...), each with its keyring hole and details.

blocks.name: Keyring lug
blocks.for: Weld a keyring lug onto any outline and cut its hole, and find where a dragged hole lands on the edge.

blocks.name: Flat keychain profile
blocks.for: A whole flat keychain: a plate round the letters with a keyring lug, and the letters themselves.

blocks.name: Text as shapes
blocks.for: Text or one symbol as centred islands in millimetres, ready to cut, engrave or extrude (built on Text to outlines).

blocks.name: Laser operations
blocks.for: Cut, score and engrave: their colours, names and the order a job runs them in.

blocks.name: Materials and sheets
blocks.for: The sheet materials with their thickness and how they burn, and the sheet sizes.

blocks.name: Material preview
blocks.for: A 3D preview of cut pieces in their material, flat or posed as assembled, with options for its camera, lights and grid, a shadow under the product, zoom tools, clicking a piece, and labels pinned to points in the scene.
